title: fix(axis3 L2): own-start stub populates _hxlcl_environ from envp — env() works in own-linked binaries
body: axis-③ L2: own-start _start stub now populates _hxlcl_environ from the entry-stack envp, so env()/getenv work in an own-linked (--linker=hexa, crt-less) binary. Root cause: the hand stub bypasses runtime.a asm _start/_hx_start_c (hxlcl_environ=envp) + synthesizes .init_array zero-trip → _hxlcl_environ .bss cell stays NULL → hxlcl_getenv returns "" for every key → cc_self cant read HEXA_PREBUILT_RUNTIME/HOME/HEXA_BACKEND (self-host blocker). Fix (linker-only, elf_x86_64.hexa link_elf_x86_64_ownstart): pre-scan objs for a DEFINED _hxlcl_environ; if present, emit a 35-byte v4 stub (lea rdx,[rsp+rdi*8+16] envp + mov [rip+d32],rdx) and hand-patch the d32 to the .bss cell vaddr after the data blob is final; else the plain 23-byte stub (no-runtime unit-test links byte-identical). Shipping --emit=obj path untouched (system CC links; runtime own _start sets environ). Design: Fable; root cause via disasm falsifying the workflows codegen-tag-drop theory.

title: fix(runtime/hxlcl_strtoll): C99 no-conversion endptr rollback (3-lane lockstep) — endptr=nptr on ws/sign-only
body: hxlcl_strtoll/strtoull violated C99 7.22.1.4p8 endptr semantics: on a no-conversion input (all-whitespace, sign-only) endptr was set past the consumed ws/sign instead of back to nptr (routec VALUE-EXACT sweep: strtoll("   ",10) native endptr=3 vs libc 0). Root cause is the FROZEN FLOOR (self/runtime.c unconditional *endptr=s), byte-faithfully ported to the native. 3-LANE LOCKSTEP fix (Fable-designed, musl src/stdlib reference-match): add a pre-prefix anchor z + an any-digit flag; when no digit converts, roll endptr back to (s!=z ? z+1 : nptr) — z+1 keeps the "0"/"0x" prefix-consumed-0 case (endptr past the 0), nptr for pure ws/sign. Value always 0 (endptr-only). Lanes: emitter self/runtime_emit_full.hexa (shipping runtime.c strtoll+strtoull), native stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa (Route C, strtoll+strtoull), shim frozen-branch self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa (strtoll). Side-fixes 2 latent caller bugs (hexa_pinned_epoch mis-pinning SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="   " to 0; to_int edge cases converge to intended throw-on-non-integer). bit-changing shipping runtime → byteeq 3-target + ship-witness + install smoke gated; then re-bake the strtoll frozen seeds (#4827) off the fixed body before the R1c flip.

title: fix(tool/routec_strtoll_verify): measure strtoll in isolation — address-range [B] + provider-link [C], catches value divergence

Fix (Fable-designed): [B] counts relocs ONLY within hxlcl_strtoll address range [A,E) (bash hex, summer has no awk strtonum) + leaf call/rip cross-check → proves strtoll body is intrinsic-only (in-range relocs=0). [C] links strtoll_only.o + loose shim_on.o (hxlcl_malloc, no strtoll) + the whole canonical runtime.a as an archive (resolves _hx_* + transitive on-demand) with --allow-multiple-definition (native strtoll wins loose-first, _start→C CRT; the value MISMATCH it surfaces proves native — not libc — is under test, ruling out false-PASS). MEASURE-ONLY, byteeq-neutral. Now RUNS the value sweep and CAUGHT a real native endptr divergence (strtoll all-whitespace: native endptr=3 vs libc 0) — the flip gate works.

title: feat(runtime/selfemit): RFC061 §M8 SELFEMIT-FCNTL — x86_64-linux ELF hxlcl_fcntl native .o (HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL, default-OFF)
body: feat(runtime): extend the darwin-arm64 SELFEMIT `fcntl` member to x86_64-linux via a self-contained ELF64 ET_REL emitter. NEW test/native_build/emit_hxlcl_fcntl_elf_o.hexa clones the strlen ELF fixture (emit_hxlcl_strlen_elf_o.hexa) — x86_64 arm emits the 8-byte class-C 3-arg NON-errno syscall leaf `mov eax,72; syscall; ret` (b8 48 00 00 00 / 0f 05 / c3; SYS_fcntl=72, C args rdi/rsi/rdx pass straight through to the kernel, no register shuffle), exports ONE strong global `hxlcl_fcntl` (bare, no `_`), NO reloc / NO errno provider / NO external callee (mirrors the darwin no-_cf leaf which likewise returns the raw trap result). arm64 = FAIL (arm64-linux fcntl is SYS 25 / svc #0, distinct from the darwin SYS 92 / svc #0x80 bytes — next rung). tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a: new SELFEMIT-FCNTL block after the SELFEMIT-STRLEN `fi` (:1645), gated `HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL=1 && Linux && x86_64|amd64` (x86_64-only like RT-NATIVE-FMOD :1704); on success appends -DHEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL to _mo_shim_def + build/hxlcl_fcntl_native.o to _mo_hxlcl_members; the shim #ifndef guard already exists (self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa:1415). CO-DROP verified SAFE: fcntl is absent from the CO-DROP registry (:1562), the MEMLEAF list (:1668), and has NO RT-NATIVE-FCNTL block, so _mo_rtnative_syms can never contain 'fcntl' → exactly ONE provider, zero ld -r multidef risk (defensive case-skip added anyway for forward-safety, no-op today); no registry entry added (no seed to mirror per selfemit-smoke-4591-codrop-default-mismatch). DEFAULT-OFF (unset) → block + elif both skipped → _mo_shim_def / _mo_hxlcl_members unchanged → shim.o + runtime.a byte-identical (sha f2d507e1 / 151c52c8 invariant). Gate (pool aiden/summer): (1) byteeq 3-target default-OFF vs frozen; (2) member .text objdump == clang --target=x86_64-linux-gnu oracle b8 48 00 00 00 0f 05 c3; (3) LINK smoke flag-ON — ld -r multidef=0, hexa build exit42, fcntl(F_GETFL) parity vs libc. bash -n GREEN.

title: fix(emit): axis-① #4867 FLOOR-ALIAS `own` 예약어 지역변수 → own_name rename (build_aprime transpile 파싱에러 해소)
body: #4867(e9d5fa0f4)이 compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa link_elf_x86_64_ownstart의 (A0) FLOOR-NAME ALIAS 패스에서 `let own = "hxlcl_" + bare`로 예약어 `own`(ownership/borrow lane)을 지역변수명으로 사용 → strict parser가 `unexpected token Own ('own')`로 거부, tool/build_aprime.sh stage [2/5] transpile 중단 → from-source 자기빌드(build_aprime→aprime_cc)가 깨짐. CI selfhost-gates는 prebuilt hexat 부트스트랩이라 신규 소스를 strict parser로 재파싱하지 않아 통과했고, fresh build_aprime flatten(pool)에서 노출됨. 실제 self-host 빌드 회귀. FIX=surgical rename only — 지역변수 `own`→`own_name` 2군데(선언 :1867 + `def_names[odi] == own_name` 비교 :1870). 주석/무관 코드의 `own`(own-link·@own·own-emit·own-start 등)은 미변경. A1 __errno_location 프로바이더 블록도 예약어-as-identifier 재점검 → 충돌 없음(errno_*/eci/eco/ecr/er/esym/enm/ek/eb/ez 모두 비예약어). pool build_aprime로 발견. 별개 이슈(own-link 결정성 + Route C errno-smoke)는 본 커밋 범위 밖, 별도 추적.

title: fix(link/ownstart): axis-① bug3 근인 종결 — archive_extract_fixpoint STB_LOCAL hxlcl_ floor-body pull + census data-driven alias → n_dyn→0 정적링크
body: axis-① bug3(`hexa build --target=linux-x86_64-glibc --linker=hexa` 가 PT_INTERP+n_dyn≈39 dyn-hybrid ELF 을 내 rc139 crash) 근인 확정: 진짜 게이트는 archive_extract_fixpoint. 그 member-pull 결정은 GLOBAL/WEAK def만 `wants`로 보는 armap 의미론인데, floor 바디 hxlcl_<X>는 STB_LOCAL(nm t)라 그것들을 담은 member가 절대 pull되지 않음 → bare floor UND <X>가 linked obj list에 부재 → census쪽 bare→hxlcl alias(A0 #4867 hardcoded-14, #4870 data-driven-all)가 아무것도 못 찾고(oidx<0) 빈집합 alias → n_dyn이 ≈39로 남아 PT_INTERP. 두 선행 fix가 동일하게 inert였던 이유 = 둘 다 hxlcl_<X>가 이미 pull되어 def_names에 있다고 가정했으나 member 자체가 pull된 적 없음. fix(2 loci, reference=`-static` armap 정답지 — armap은 멤버십만 결정, visibility는 body에 직접 bind): LOCUS-1 archive_extract_fixpoint에 own-link floor-pull 예외 추가 — GLOBAL/WEAK `wants`가 false일 때 und_names의 still-NEEDED bare <X>의 hxlcl_<X> body(any binding, section!=0)가 이 member에 있으면 wants=true로 pull, 그리고 GLOBAL-def fold 뒤에 미러 fold로 bare <X>를 def_names에 push(fixpoint 종료). LOCUS-2 census쪽 A0 alias를 hardcoded-14 블록 삭제 후 census 루프 내 data-driven으로 이동(runtime_defs>0 gate) — bare UND dnm이 undef이고 ldx에 hxlcl_<dnm>(LOCUS-1이 pull)이 있으면 그 seg/off에 GLOBAL bare alias를 synth하고 ldx에 index, ddef=true → dyn_names 미진입 → n_dyn→0 → STATIC serializer(no PT_INTERP) → raw-syscall exit, ld.so 없음. A1 __errno_location native provider는 그대로 유지. HEXA_LD_DUMP_DYN 진단 덤프 신규 추가(n_dyn+DYN-UND 리스트, env-gated, byte-neutral)로 pool 측정 가능. --linker=hexa opt-in 전용 — archive_extract_fixpoint/link_elf_x86_64_ownstart 는 link_elf_x86_64_ownstart_ar 경로에서만 도달, shipping C-transpile는 system ld 사용하므로 runtime.a symbol visibility 불변 → byteeq-neutral. 미검증: pool compile+run이 게이트(mini=git/gh only).

title: fix(emit): axis-① bug3 진단덤프 getenv→env_var (build_aprime transpile 타입에러 해소)
body: bug3 fix(d53870679)가 compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa 에 추가한 HEXA_LD_DUMP_DYN 진단덤프(n_dyn + DYN-UND 리스트)가 env-reader로 getenv("HEXA_LD_DUMP_DYN") 를 호출 → 하지만 getenv 는 이 모듈에서 hexa-callable 이 아니라 C libc getenv 함수타입으로 resolve되어 len(getenv(...)) 가 `passing char*(const char*) to HexaVal` 타입에러 → pool build_aprime.sh transpile(ap_post.c) 중단. FIX=getenv→env_var 1군데 교체 — env_var 는 bind.hexa:1635 에 hexa_env_var(runtime.c) 로 등록된 정식 hexa-callable(hexa string 반환)이며 compiler/check/types.hexa·codegen/nvptx_* 에서 HEXA_* env 게이트에 광범위 사용됨 → len(env_var(...))>0 정상 타입. 진단덤프 보존. 코어 LOCUS1(archive_extract_fixpoint floor-pull)/LOCUS2(census data-driven alias) 무변경. flag-OFF 경로 byte-neutral. pool compile+run이 게이트.

title: fix(link/ownstart): axis-① bug3 CRT1-HANDOFF — n_dyn>0시 crt1.o _start 진입점+own stub 억제로 glibc teardown 계약 충족(rc139 치유)·n_dyn=0시 pure own-start 자동복귀
body: axis-① bug3의 잔여 exit-crash 종결(#4871 extraction floor-pull이 dyn imports 39→20으로 줄였으나 clang-runtime.a의 genuine libc UND 20개는 hxlcl_ 별칭 불가라 잔존 → PT_INTERP 유지). 근인: own raw-syscall `_start` stub이 ld.so와 공존 불가 — PT_INTERP 바이너리에서 ld.so가 이미 glibc TLS init을 마쳤고 __libc_start_main/_dl_fini teardown을 기대하는데 stub의 bare exit_group이 계약 위반 → exit시 rc139(SIGSEGV). FIX(Path 2 CRT1-HANDOFF, gated n_dyn>0, 4 loci, all in compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa): 동적링크(PT_INTERP+DT_NEEDED libc.so.6+GLOB_DAT-only stub, 기존 동작)는 유지하고 ENTRY CONTRACT만 교체. LOCUS-1 _census_resid_und(objs) pure helper — floor-pull 후 남는 genuine libc UND(정의無·hxlcl_ 별칭無·synth/errno·hexa-prefix 제외)를 1024-bkt _ldx_hash 인덱스로 O(relocs·bucket) 수집; runtime_defs>0 gate + len>0 = crt_handoff. LOCUS-2 진입선택 — crt_handoff시 (a)23/35B own stub 전면 억제(env_cell=false 포함)+call-main 패치 skip, (b)_ld_read_crt1()로 sysroot crt1.o를 prepend(obj[0]→.text offset 0), (c)_start 심볼조회로 entry_off 결정, (d)GOT base에 `_GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_` linker-synth GLOBAL def(resolve pass generic PC-rel arm이 S+A-P 계산). crt1의 `_start`가 rdx=&_dl_fini(ld.so) 받아 __libc_start_main(main,argc,argv,…) 호출 → init→main→exit→_IO_cleanup flush→_dl_fini→clean exit_group. LOCUS-3 serialize_elf_exec_x86_64_dyn에 entry_off:Int 파라미터 추가(e_entry=vaddr_base+code_off+entry_off); 유일 호출부만 entry_off 전달, static/2seg serializer 무변경+entry_off=0=byte-identical. LOCUS-4 _ld_read_crt1() = env_var("HEXA_LD_SYSROOT")/crt1.o else /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/crt1.o → parse_elf_x86_obj(midx=777001 유니크); 파일부재시 hard-error rc=3. floor가 ∅(L3/RFC061)로 드레인되면 _census_resid_und가 []→crt_handoff false→pure own-start static serializer 자동복귀(convergent, throwaway無). recon(aiden glibc2.39): crt1.o UND={main,__libc_start_main,_GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_}·main=R_X86_64_REX_GOTPCRELX(42)·__libc_start_main=GOTPCRELX(41)·.rela.eh_frame R_X86_64_PC32×2. (1)_GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_는 Fable {main,__libc_start_main} 넘어선 EXTRA UND — GOT base vaddr로 linker-synth def(handled). (2)kind41/42 모두 _elf_kind_is_got(:73)에 이미 배선(no relaxation, GOT-slot+GLOB_DAT) — handled. (3).eh_frame는 SHF_ALLOC→reader가 rodata pool로 흡수, PC32 relocs는 STT_SECTION synth def로 resolve(dynamic無) — handled. 잔여리스크(pool 검증): _GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_ reloc이 GOTPC32(4B, generic else 정확)이 아닌 GOTPC64(8B movabs)면 generic else가 4B만 써서 오류(현대 non-PIE crt1은 32bit lea form이라 unlikely); crt path에서 own stub 억제로 _hxlcl_environ 미population(env()="") 가능 — glibc environ 별칭은 별도 follow-on. --linker=hexa opt-in 전용(link_elf_x86_64_ownstart_ar만 runtime_defs>0 전달), shipping C-transpile=system ld 불변 → byteeq-neutral. 미검증: pool compile+run이 게이트(mini=git/gh only). 예약어 점검: own_nm(not `own`)·env_var(not getenv) 확인.

title: fix(link/ownstart): axis-① bug3 R_X86_64_COPY lane — 잔존 STT_OBJECT libc import(stdout/stderr)를 stub 대신 .bss/.data COPY-reloc로 바인딩(census가 reloc-kind 아닌 symbol-type로 분기)·exit _IO_flush_all garbage FILE* deref(rc139) 치유
body: CRT1-HANDOFF(#4871) 뒤 잔여 exit-crash 근인 종결(Fable 5 measured). own-linker의 residual-import census(dyn_stub.push 결정)가 reloc KIND로만 분기 — kind 2(R_X86_64_PC32)는 `call fn` 콜사이트 AND non-PIC RIP-rel DATA load(`mov stdout(%rip),%rdi`) 양쪽에 쓰임. 그래서 stdout/stderr(20개 residual libc import 중 유일한 STT_OBJECT data symbol 2개)가 각각 6바이트 jmp-stub(`ff 25 disp32`)을 GLOBAL text def로 synth 받고, stdout DATA load가 stub instruction 바이트를 FILE*로 읽음 → garbage 0x25ff000195a325ff(= 두 6바이트 stub 팩) → exit시 libc `_IO_flush_all`(`testl $0x8000,(%rdi)`)가 fake FILE* deref → rc139. (run-time print는 hxlcl_ write(2) lane + PIE GOTPCREL lane이 GOT slot을 정확 바인드해 동작 — non-PIC PC32 data lane만 오염.) FIX(R_X86_64_COPY lane, reference=GNU ld ET_EXEC vs shared libc, n_dyn>0/crt_handoff gate, 4 loci, all compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa): direct(non-GOT) UND STT_OBJECT 참조는 exe .bss/.data에 st_size 예약 + exe .dynsym에 DEFINED + R_X86_64_COPY emit → ld.so가 load시 libc 초기값 memcpy + libc 자체 ref를 exe copy로 rebind(exe-first). FUNCTION은 stub+GLOB_DAT lane 불변. LOCUS-A _ld_read_libc_dynsym() pure helper 신규 — parse_elf_x86_obj가 ET_REL-only(shipped .so=ET_DYN, program headers)라 focused .dynsym reader 작성: env_var("HEXA_LD_SYSROOT")/libc.so.6 else /lib·/usr/lib multiarch 둘다 probe → ELF/ET_DYN/EM_X86_64 guard → SHT_DYNSYM(11) 섹션+sh_link .dynstr → DEFINED(st_shndx!=0) 항목만 name→(st_type,st_size) 맵; 부재/파싱실패=ok=0 → crt_handoff 경로에서 hard-error(rc3, crt1.o 핸드오프와 동형). LOCUS-B census 3-way 라우팅 — 첫 조우시 libc 타입 1회 캐시(dyn_isobj), non-GOT ref마다 STT_OBJECT→dyn_copy·STT_FUNC/unknown→dyn_stub(불변)·GOT-only→dyn_stub=0(GLOB_DAT 불변). LOCUS-C COPY synthesis — dyn_copy마다 st_size(8-align,>8=16) RW data blob 예약+bare name을 GLOBAL data def(def_seg=1,def_obj=-1)로 등록(_GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_ synth와 동형)→generic resolve pass가 PC32 data load를 copy로, GOT-fill이 GOT slot을 copy로 바인드. LOCUS-D .dynsym에 copy 심볼은 DEFINED entry(st_info=(GLOBAL<<4)|OBJECT, st_shndx=2=RW seg(≠UNDEF; e_shnum=0라 ld.so는 l_addr+st_value만 사용, section header deref 안함), st_value=copy vaddr, st_size=libc 실측 — ld.so COPY memcpy 길이라 정확必), .rela.dyn에 GLOB_DAT 대신 R_X86_64_COPY(type 5, r_offset=copy vaddr). rela count=n_dyn 불변→DT_RELASZ 불변. libc_dyn 읽기=crt_handoff gate(=n_dyn>0 실제 경로)·off 경로는 map 빈empty→_libc_sym_type 전부 FUNC→dyn_copy 미설정→copy_names empty→dynsym/rela else-arm=pre-COPY 바이트 동일. static serializer/2seg/n_dyn==0 경로 무변경(byteeq). LOCUS-A는 focused .so reader 채택(stdout/stderr special-case fallback 미사용) — libc.so.6가 section header 보유해 general path가 blocked 아님·st_size는 타입분류와 동일 entry에서 취득해 wrong-size 리스크 0(OBJECT로 분류=found=실size). 예약어 점검: `own` 미사용(dyn_copy/copy_names/csz/coff 등)·env read=env_var(not getenv). --linker=hexa opt-in 전용, shipping C-transpile=system ld 불변→byteeq-neutral. 잔여리스크(pool 검증): (1)st_shndx=2 임의 non-special index가 ld.so check_match/do_lookup에서 stdout/stderr defined로 수용되는지(l_addr+st_value 경로 기대), (2)stdout이 kind9 GOTPCREL도 가지면 copy로 라우팅되어 GOT slot은 static-fill(copy vaddr)+GLOB_DAT 미emit인데 ld.so가 slot 미터치 확인, (3)libc.so.6 dynsym st_size=8(FILE* word) 실측 확인. 미검증: pool compile+run+exit rc가 게이트(mini=git/gh only).

title: feat(axis-③/PR-1): own-link default-flip opt-in leg — HEXA_OWNLINK_DEFAULT=1 host build via hexa_ld (clang-0 + binutils-0)
body: axis-③ endgame PR-1 (roadmap state/hexa-own/axis3-ownlink-default-flip-roadmap.md). Inserts an own-link OPT-IN leg in self/main.hexa cmd_build immediately before the tier-B HEXA_BUILD_NATIVE leg: when HEXA_OWNLINK_DEFAULT=1 + host uname==Linuxx86_64 + !shared + !c_only + len(target)==0 + src>0, route the build through own-emit + own-LINK (_drv.hexa --backend=native --emit=exec --linker=hexa) = ZERO clang AND ZERO system ld. Mirrors the proven tier-C cross leg (HEXA_BUILD_NATIVE_CROSS) but host-native. ANY emit/own-link failure falls through to tier-B (aprime --emit=obj + system ld), C-transpile delegate intact — release integrity preserved. Default-OFF = byte-neutral (tier-B path unchanged when unset). The default-ON flip (==1 -> !=0) is PR-2, gated on byteeq 3-target + ownlink-corpus-parity + shipping/install smoke. Own-emit+own-link proven this session end-to-end (struct-of-arrays repro 5020100 rc=0, ELF x86-64, --linker=hexa). Follow-on in PR-1: cmd_run:4680 gate extension, DT_INIT_ARRAY dyn-serializer wiring (elf_x86_64.hexa SHT_INIT_ARRAY drop), ownlink-corpus-parity CI job.

title: feat(axis-③/PR-1): own-link runs .init_array ctors (SHT_INIT_ARRAY pool + static _hx_start_c entry + dyn DT_INIT_ARRAY)
body: hexa_ld own ELF linker previously DROPPED SHT_INIT_ARRAY input sections (reader Pass A pooled only PROGBITS/NOBITS) → __init_array_start==__init_array_end → runtime.a .init_array constructors SILENTLY SKIPPED on both own-link paths. Fix (Fable E1-E10, state/hexa-own/axis3-dtinitarray-ownlink-ctor-design.md, compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa): E3 pool SHT_INIT_ARRAY into ElfX86Obj.init_array (slot 6); E8 materialize a contiguous output .init_array region (link order) + set boundary syms to real [start,end) + register deferred section-6 syms; E9 resolve site_seg==6 R_X86_64_64 (kind 1) entries to final ctor vaddrs; static path (E4-E6) routes entry through a 16-byte stub calling runtime.a _hx_start_c (which walks [__init_array_start,__init_array_end) + atexit-drain exit) with a loud-fail gate when ctors present but no scaffold; dyn path (E10) emits DT_INIT_ARRAY(25)/DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ(27) so ld.so runs them — exactly one mechanism per path (no double-run). byteeq: ctor-free links (own-emit unit tests, ownlink_determinism no-runtime) are BIT-IDENTICAL (init_total==0 → no pad/region/stub/tags); runtime.a own-link is NOT byte-neutral by construction (hxlcl_capture_environ is constructor(101) unconditionally) — a parity GAIN matching system-ld semantics, own-link determinism gate stays green (deterministic fn of input), golden needs re-baseline. Scoped out: cross-obj priority-sort, SHT_PREINIT_ARRAY, .fini_array. Verify (aiden): ctor.c write CTOR + main.hexa own-link → CTOR before MAIN (static+dyn); no-ctor byte-identical; build x2 determinism.

title: fix(axis-③/PR-1): drop dyn DT_INIT_ARRAY — OWN_START ctors regress under glibc _dl_init
body: Fable root-cause: DT_INIT_ARRAY-on-dyn made glibc _dl_init run an extraction-accident subset of runtime.a OWN_START (-DHEXA_ZEROC_OWN_START) static ctors assuming the _hx_start_c contract → out-of-context partial init → mir3 own-link rc 0→2. Fix: delete the dyn DT_INIT_ARRAY/SZ emission; dyn(crt_handoff) reverts to status-quo (glibc runs zero exe ctors). Keep E3/E7-E9 pooling+region+reloc + E5/E6 static stub (dead today, always-dyn via RFC061 floor, kept for resid-UND→0 endgame). env empty on dyn = pre-existing (hxlcl_getenv no libc fallback). Verify: mir3 5020 rc=0, no DT_INIT_ARRAY, no-ctor byte-id.

title: fix(axis-③/PR-1): gate .init_array region materialization on init_stub (static path only)
body: MEASURED: dropping DT_INIT_ARRAY alone left rc 0->2 — E8 region materialization set __init_array_start/end to REAL bounds, a runtime path (_hx_run_init_array) walked them -> OWN_START ctors ran out-of-context even without DT_INIT_ARRAY. Fix: gate region concat + deferred section-6 registration + E9 site_seg==6 reloc on init_stub (static path). Dyn (crt_handoff) keeps region EMPTY -> start==end -> _hx_run_init_array no-op -> byte-identical, rc=0. Pooling+static stub kept (inert today; RFC061 static endgame). Verify: mir3 5020 rc=0; dyn byte-identical.

title: ci(axis-③/PR-1): own-link corpus RUN-parity gate (own-link vs ld · PR-2 default-flip evidence)
body: New advisory CI gate tool/ownlink_corpus_parity_gate + job ownlink-corpus-parity-x86_64 (nobaseline-gate.yml, mirrors ownlink-determinism-x86_64). For each of a self-contained corpus (arith·packed [i64] array·struct-of-arrays [#4873 BUG-B construct]·string·while-loop), emit ONE own-backend .o then link TWO ways — own-link (--linker=hexa/hexa_ld) vs system ld (--emit=obj+gcc) — and assert stdout+exit-rc identical. Isolates the LINKER. This is the PR-2 own-link default-flip evidence: a mislinked-but-executable binary does not trip the build fall-through, so RUN-parity is the only sound gate. Advisory (promote into the required selfhost-gates-summary set after a green soak). INFRA(non-eval) exits (rc=2) quarantine toolchain walls from the parity verdict.

title: feat(axis-③/PR-2): own-link default-flip DEFAULT-ON (linux-x86_64 hexa build → hexa_ld, opt-out HEXA_OWNLINK_DEFAULT=0)
body: Flip the linux-x86_64 host hexa build default linker from system ld to own-link (hexa_ld) — clang-0 AND binutils-0. self/main.hexa cmd_build gate == 1 → != 0 (default-ON; opt-out =0 reverts to tier-B ld). Safety net survives: any emit/own-link failure still falls through to tier-B (aprime --emit=obj + system ld), C-transpile delegate intact. Evidence chain (all merged GREEN this cycle): own-emit+own-link end-to-end (#4877 opt-in leg) · DT_INIT_ARRAY ctor infra (#4878) · own-link determinism gate (emit+link twice byte-identical) · ownlink-corpus-parity gate (own-link ≡ ld stdout+rc across arith/packed-array/struct-of-arrays[#4873]/string/loop, #4881). This PR CI runs byteeq 3-target + shipping smoke + install.sh consumer smoke + the parity/determinism gates with own-link as DEFAULT — the final release-integrity evidence. Scoped to linux-x86_64 host (the leg gate); arm64/darwin keep ld (PR-3). Do NOT fast-merge: soak on the open PR (CI-green history) per release-integrity before promoting; axis-① (hexa_cc delegate removal) follows once own-link is the proven default.
